# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **$13.3M eCat GMV on 2,132 orders at $6,228 AOV** — Universal Furniture's eCat platform processes high-value transactions averaging nearly 3× the all-channel order value, all rep-submitted via iPad (trailing 12 months). [→ §commerce]
2. **9.8% GMV capture rate against a $135.9M all-channel business** — eCat captures 3.5% of order volume but 9.8% of GMV trailing 12 months, indicating reps selectively use eCat for larger transactions. Significant room to expand into mid-tier and routine reorders. [→ §commerce]
3. **Well-diversified buyer base with no concentration risk** — top 5 buyers represent only 14.0% of eCat GMV trailing 12 months, with no single buyer exceeding 3.6%. [→ §commerce]
4. **98.7% clean confirmed workflow** — nearly all eCat orders move straight to confirmed status trailing 12 months. Quote orders carry a 2.0× AOV premium ($12,216 vs. $6,228) but represent only 1.1% of volume. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Expand eCat capture rate beyond 9.8% of GMV by encouraging rep adoption for mid-value and routine reorders — shifting even 5 percentage points of all-channel volume to eCat could represent roughly $6.8M in additional digitally tracked GMV annually [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
